description: This file manages workspace packages, including versioning, consistency checks, and package file operations for the Playwright project. It defines classes for packages and workspace, and includes CLI commands for workspace maintenance.

classes.name: PWPackage
classes.description: Represents a package within the workspace, including its name, path, files, and package.json data.

classes.name: Workspace
classes.description: Manages a collection of packages, handles versioning, consistency, and file operations across the workspace.

methods.name: readJSON
methods.description: Asynchronously reads and parses a JSON file.

methods.name: writeJSON
methods.description: Asynchronously writes a JSON object to a file.

methods.name: PWPackage.constructor
methods.description: Initializes a package with descriptor data, reading its package.json.

methods.name: Workspace.constructor
methods.description: Initializes the workspace with root directory and package list.

methods.name: Workspace.packages
methods.description: Returns the list of packages in the workspace.

methods.name: Workspace.version
methods.description: Retrieves the current workspace version from root package.json.

methods.name: Workspace.setVersion
methods.description: Sets a new version for the workspace and updates all packages accordingly.

methods.name: Workspace.ensureConsistent
methods.description: Ensures workspace consistency by updating package files, package.jsons, and lockfile.
